data.name: Madeeha
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘mudhahaha’, meaning ‘to make much of something, or to glorify’. In Islamic context, it refers to the mother of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) named Amina bint Wahb, who gave him the name ‘Ahmad’ which means ‘most praiseworthy’.
